en: Plan fields, crops, rotation and margin for the whole season
Plan fields, crops, rotation, seed and margin for the season
each field's planned crop is compared with the last five seasons and flagged for the same crop or family again and for too few rest years
yield, price, direct cost, rent and other costs give the margin of every field against the margin per hectare you want
Crop budget with break-even yield and price
seed to machinery costs for one hectare show the margin and the yield and price at which a crop only covers its cost
crop, sowing and harvest dates, tonnes, revenue and margin per field, with warnings for late sowing and for a harvest date that does not fit the crop cycle
the first and last month for every crop give the open window, days left, working days and the spare days after your sowing work
Seed plan with spare and order dates
seed rate times area plus spare gives the kilograms and the cost, and an order warning appears before sowing
Soil tests with pH and organic matter checks
every test is checked against your healthy pH range and organic matter target, and old tests are flagged for each field
the target of each field is compared with the average and best yield of the same crop there and marked realistic, stretch or above the best
Land tenure with rent per tonne
owned and leased land, rent per year, rent in every tonne produced and a warning before a lease ends
Water need by crop and month
the water each crop needs in each month is set against usable rain to show the shortfall in mm and in cubic metres per hectare
each trial plot is compared with your usual variety and given a verdict to adopt, keep testing or drop, with the value gained per hectare
hectares planned for every crop are compared with the hectares you want, and the gap and a check show where the plan is off

Fields register: area, soil, water and what grows now
One row for each field with area, soil, irrigation and supervisor; tenure, crop, status, sowing date, latest soil test and the pH and organic matter checks fill in by themselves.
Crops and varieties with yield, price, water and margin
One row for each crop with cycle, target yield, price, seed rate, water and rest years between crops; hectares planned, production, margin per hectare, break-even price and rank fill in.
Season plan: which crop goes in which field and when
One row for each field and season with crop, sowing and harvest dates and area; tonnes, revenue, cost, margin, days to sowing, planting window and checks fill in.
Rotation history: the last five seasons of every field
One row for each field and year with the crop grown and the yield reached; the crop group and the yield against the crop target fill in.
Rotation check: the planned crop against what grew before
One row for each field; the planned crop, last crop, years since the same crop, rest years needed and a verdict on repeats of the same crop or family fill in.
Yield targets against what each field has really produced
One row for each field with the target yield you set; the planned crop, the average and best yield of that crop in the field, the gap and a verdict fill in.
Crop budget for one hectare, margin and break-even
One row for each crop with the cost of seed, fertiliser, protection, water, labour, machinery and other items for one hectare; total, margin, break-even yield and price fill in.
Gross margin forecast for each field
One row for each field; adjust the yield and the price and add other costs; revenue, direct cost, rent, margin per hectare and a check against your target fill in.
Seed plan: kilograms to order for every sowing
One row for each sowing with seed rate, spare share, price, supplier and order date; area, kilograms to order, cost and an order warning fill in.
Soil test results: pH, organic matter and nutrients
One row for each soil test with pH, organic matter, nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium; the pH and organic matter checks and the age of the test fill in.
Soil improvement: lime, compost, cover crop, drainage
One row for each job with rate per hectare, unit price, planned and finished dates and the provider; area, quantity, cost and a status fill in.
Land tenure and rent: who owns each field and what it costs
One row for each field with owned or leased land, the landowner, rent per hectare and lease dates; area, rent per year, rent per tonne and a lease warning fill in.
One row for each boundary or access point with the neighbour, boundary kind, agreement, length and last check; days since the check and a reminder fill in.
Field problems: waterlogging, erosion, stones and compaction
One row for each problem with area affected, expected yield loss and cost to fix; share of the field, tonnes and value lost and how long it has been open fill in.
Variety trials: plot, variety, yield and verdict
One row for each trial plot with its variety, yield and the yield of your usual variety; gain, value per hectare and a verdict to adopt, keep testing or drop fill in.
Planting windows: when each crop can be sown
One row for each crop with the first and last month it can be sown and the best month; the next or current window, days left, working days and whether it is open fill in.
One row for each crop and month with the water the crop needs and the rain you expect; the rain the crop can use, the shortfall in mm and in cubic metres per hectare fill in.
One row for each cover crop with species, dates, seed rate and the nitrogen it adds; seed cost, nitrogen in kg, days to termination and a status fill in.
Land use balance: hectares per crop against target
One row for each crop with the hectares you want; hectares planned, share of the farm, gap to the target and a check fill in from the season plan.
Crop calendar: sowing, care and harvest by month
One row for each crop, month and activity with the labour hours for one hectare; the hectares, total hours, labour cost and whether it is done, this month or coming fill in.

Hello {supervisor}, sowing starts on {name} on {sow_date}. The crop is {crop} on {area_ha} ha. Please confirm the seedbed, the seed and the machines the day before.
Hello {supervisor}, the seedbed on {name} is not ready for {crop}. Please tell me what is missing, such as rain, levelling or weeds, and when you expect it to be fine.
Hello {supervisor}, we will walk {name} together tomorrow at 7:00 to check emergence, weeds and any wet or stony patches. Please bring the field notes.

Hello {supervisor}, you lead the soil sampling team on {name} ({area_ha} ha). The last test was on {last_test}. Take samples across the whole field in a W pattern and send them to the laboratory the same day.
Hello, the plan leaves {field} fallow this season ({area_ha} ha, planned crop {crop}). Please confirm whether it stays fallow or whether we sow a cover crop.
Hello, the planting window for {crop} closes in {win_left} days. {field} is planned for sowing on {sow_date}. Please plan machines and seed so that we finish in time.
Staff: season plan for the week
Hello, the plan for {field}: {crop}, sowing on {sow_date}, harvest on {harvest_date}, {area_ha} ha. Please read it and tell me about any problem before Friday.
Hello, we hold the season review for {field} this week. We will look at {crop}, the sowing date of {sow_date} and the planned margin of {margin}. Please bring your notes.
Hello, sowing of {crop} on {field} was due on {sow_date}. Please tell me the reason for the delay and the new date today.
Hello, the target of {target_t_ha} t/ha for {crop} on {field} is above the past average of {avg_hist} t/ha. Please review the target or the crop plan before we order inputs.
Hello, the rotation check for {field} shows a problem: {crop} after {last_crop}. Verdict: {state}. Please suggest another crop or confirm the exception.
Hello, the budget for {crop} costs {total_ha} per hectare and leaves a margin of {margin_ha} per hectare. The break-even price is {be_price} per tonne. Please review the inputs before we order.
Hello, we confirm our order of {need_kg} kg of {crop} seed for {field}. Please deliver before {sow_date} and send the lot numbers and the germination result with the delivery.
Hello, we need to move the delivery of {crop} seed for {field}. Sowing is on {sow_date}. Can you deliver at least five days before that date?
Hello, please send your best price for {need_kg} kg of {crop} seed, with the delivery date and the payment terms. We pay about {price_kg} per kg now.
Hello, the invoice for {crop} seed for {field} does not match our order of {need_kg} kg at {price_kg} per kg. Please check it and send a corrected invoice or a credit note.
Hello, we sent soil samples from {field} today. We need pH, organic matter, nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium. Please confirm that you received them.
Hello, we need the soil results for {field} (sampled on {date}) by the end of next week, because the fertiliser plan and the lime order depend on them. Please send the report as soon as you can.
Hello, trial {plot} on {field} compares {variety} of {crop} with our usual variety. Can we meet this week to choose the varieties for next season?
Hello, please read trial {plot} on {field} ({variety}, {crop}) tomorrow: count plants, measure height and note disease. Send me the numbers by the evening.
Hello {landowner}, the rent for {field} is {rent_year} for the year. We will pay it on the agreed date. Please send your bank details again if they changed.
Hello {landowner}, the lease of {field} ends on {lease_end}. We would like to renew it. Can we meet to talk about the rent and a longer term?
Hello {landowner}, we plan to drill {field} soon. Please confirm that the gate is open and that we may cross the neighbouring track with the machines.
Hello {neighbour}, the {boundary} between our field {field} and your land needs repair. It is {length_m} m long. Can we agree who does the work and when?
Hello, please deliver {qty} {unit} for {field} ({action}) around {planned}. Tell us the day and the size of the truck so that we can prepare the spreader.
Hello, we would like to book you for {action} on {field}, {area} ha, around {planned}. Please send your price and your first free date.
Hello, we need ploughing on {field} ({area} ha) before sowing. Please tell me your first free date after {planned} and your price per hectare.
Hello {owner}, {kind} on {field}: {ha_affected} ha are affected and the problem is marked {severity}. Please start the repair this week and report back.
Hello, we sow {species} as a cover crop on {field} ({area_ha} ha). Please prepare the drill and {seed_kg} kg of seed.
Hello, the cover crop on {field} is due to end on {end_date}. Please plan mowing or rolling and tell me when it is done.
Sample wording: adapt it to your country's law and your own practice.

We plan to sow {col:plan.area_ha} hectares on {col:plan.sow_date} and to harvest on {col:plan.harvest_date}. The planned yield is {col:plan.yield_t} tonnes per hectare, which gives {col:plan.tonnes} tonnes.
The planned revenue is {col:plan.revenue} and the planned cost is {col:plan.cost}, so the planned margin is {col:plan.margin}. The sowing check shows: {col:plan.check}.
The supervisor sows only when the seedbed is ready and the seed and the machines are on site. Any change of date or crop is written on this plan and signed below.
Field: {col:fields.name}, {col:fields.block}. Area: {col:fields.area_ha} hectares. Soil type: {col:fields.soil}. Irrigation: {col:fields.irrigation}.
This season the field carries {col:fields.crop}. Its status is {col:fields.status} and the sowing date is {col:fields.sow_date}.

The latest soil test was on {col:fields.last_test}: pH {col:fields.ph} and organic matter {col:fields.om}. The pH check shows {col:fields.ph_state} and the organic matter check shows {col:fields.om_state}.
This passport stays with the field records and is updated after every soil test and every change of crop.

For one hectare the budget holds seed {col:budget.seed}, fertiliser {col:budget.fert}, crop protection {col:budget.protect}, water {col:budget.water}, labour {col:budget.labour}, machinery {col:budget.machinery} and other costs {col:budget.other}. The total is {col:budget.total_ha}.
At a yield of {col:budget.yield_t} tonnes per hectare and a price of {col:budget.price_t} per tonne the revenue is {col:budget.revenue_ha} and the margin is {col:budget.margin_ha} per hectare.

The crop breaks even at {col:budget.be_yield} tonnes per hectare or at a price of {col:budget.be_price} per tonne. The budget for the whole area is {col:budget.budget}. The margin check shows: {col:budget.state}.
The last crop on this field was {col:rotchk.last_crop} in {col:rotchk.last_year}. The planned crop was last grown {col:rotchk.since} years ago and needs {col:rotchk.rest} rest years.
The rotation check shows: {col:rotchk.state}, with a fit score of {col:rotchk.score} out of 100. The check was made by {col:rotchk.checked_by} on {col:rotchk.checked_on}.
If the check shows a problem, the crop manager either changes the crop or writes the reason for the exception and the extra care that the field will get.

The soil pH is {col:soil.ph} ({col:soil.ph_state}). The organic matter is {col:soil.om} ({col:soil.om_state}). Nitrogen is {col:soil.n_ppm}, phosphorus is {col:soil.p_ppm} and potassium is {col:soil.k_ppm} milligrams per kilogram.
The test is {col:soil.age_days} days old and the age check shows: {col:soil.state}. The healthy pH range in our plan is {set:min_ph} to {set:max_ph}.
The fertiliser and lime plan for this field must follow these results. A field with a low pH needs lime before the next sowing.

We order {col:seed.need_kg} kilograms of seed at {col:seed.price_kg} per kilogram. The order value is {col:seed.cost}. The seed rate is {col:seed.rate_kg_ha} kilograms per hectare with a spare share of {col:seed.spare}.
We sow on {col:seed.sow_date}. Please deliver before that date, with the lot number, the germination result and the purity of the seed on the delivery note.
Please confirm the order and the delivery date by return message.
The agreed rent is {col:lease.rent_ha} per hectare, which is {col:lease.rent_year} per year. The lease started on {col:lease.lease_start} and ends on {col:lease.lease_end}.
We plan to produce {col:lease.prod} tonnes on the field this season, so the rent is {col:lease.rent_t} for each tonne. The lease check shows: {col:lease.state}.
We would like to talk about the renewal before the lease ends. Please tell us a day that suits you.
Gross margin report for a crop

The crop gives {col:budget.revenue_ha} of revenue and {col:budget.total_ha} of cost for each hectare. The gross margin is {col:budget.margin_ha} per hectare, or {col:budget.margin_pct} of the revenue. Our target is {set:target_gm_ha} per hectare.
The margin check shows: {col:budget.state}. The crop covers its cost at {col:budget.be_price} per tonne. The planned budget for the area is {col:budget.budget}.
We use this report to decide how many hectares each crop gets next season.
Yearly land use report for a crop

The target is {col:landuse.target_ha} hectares. The plan holds {col:landuse.planned_ha} hectares, which is {col:landuse.share} of the planned area. The gap to the target is {col:landuse.gap} hectares.
The land use check shows: {col:landuse.state}. A gap larger than {set:land_tol} of the target needs a reason in the season review.
